results.prompt: How many days of paid outpatient sick leave do eligible employees receive per calendar year?
results.answer:
According to the **ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES**, eligible employees and interns receive up to **14 days** of paid outpatient sick leave per calendar year, compensated at 100% of their base salary. Part-time and fixed-term employees receive prorated leave based on their contracted working hours.

**Source Information:**
* **Title:** ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES
* **Source URI:** `gs://project-elevate-503008-hr-policy/approved/altostrat-singapore-employee-policy-handbook.pdf`

results.prompt: What are the annual vacation accrual tiers for 1-6, 7-10, and 11+ years of service?
results.answer:
Based on the **ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES**, the annual vacation accrual tiers based on continuous years of service are as follows:

* **1 to 6 years of service:** 20 days per year
* **7 to 10 years of service:** 21 days per year
* **11+ years of service (11 years and above):** 22 days per year

**Source Information:**
* **Title:** ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES
* **Source URI:** `gs://project-elevate-503008-hr-policy/approved/altostrat-singapore-employee-policy-handbook.pdf`

results.prompt: What is the daily meal reimbursement limit on a global business trip?
results.answer:
According to the **ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES**:

* **Daily Meal Limit:** Reimbursement for individual meals on global business trips is capped at **US $120 (or equivalent) per employee per day**.
* **Requirement:** This is not a per diem; all meal expenses must be individually detailed with receipts.

**Source:**
* Title: ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES
* Source URI: `gs://project-elevate-503008-hr-policy/approved/altostrat-singapore-employee-policy-handbook.pdf`

results.prompt: Within how many days must medical insurance claims be submitted?
results.answer:
All medical claims must be submitted within **30 days** of the treatment date. Late submissions may be rejected by the insurance provider.

**Source:**
* **Title:** ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES
* **URI:** gs://project-elevate-503008-hr-policy/approved/altostrat-singapore-employee-policy-handbook.pdf

results.prompt: Does the handbook provide a monthly cryptocurrency stipend?
results.answer:
Based on the available policy handbook documentation, there is no mention of a monthly cryptocurrency stipend. The handbook specifies eligible allowances for employees as monthly internet reimbursements, wellness/gym subsidies, and mobile phone allowances (Source: *ALTOSTRAT SINGAPORE EMPLOYEE POLICY HANDBOOK & CONDUCT GUIDELINES*, `gs://project-elevate-503008-hr-policy/approved/altostrat-singapore-employee-policy-handbook.pdf`). 

Because a monthly cryptocurrency stipend cannot be verified in the HR policy documentation, please reach out directly to HR for further clarification.
